card.name: Equipment nouns after infusion or delivery
card.fires_on: The noun naming equipment (line, set, system) right after intravenous, infusion or delivery, in administration instructions. The next words usually describe what the equipment must have or be capable of.

modes.label: Infusion line or set
modes.description: The noun line or set after intravenous or infusion, followed by filter or dedicated-use details.
modes.example: using an infusion<< set>> equipped with a 0.2 micron

modes.label: Oxygen delivery system
modes.description: The noun system after delivery in airway and ventilation emergency text, followed by capable of.
modes.example: with a delivery<< system>> capable of permitting immediate positive airway pressure

card.writes: It promotes words like operating, capable and tuned, which suggest a description of what the equipment can do or how it works.
card.plain: It marks the equipment word in 'infusion set' or 'delivery system' just before the label says what that equipment must be able to do.
